changes.description: New webhook event `payment.settled` for settlement confirmations
Deprecated `account_number` in favor of `wallet_address` in payment payloads
Fixed pagination metadata returning incorrect `total_count` for filtered queries
Introduced `GET /v1/exchange-rates` for real-time currency conversion data
Added optional `callback_url` parameter to payment creation
Resolved timeout issue on low-balance payment validations
Fixed HMAC signature mismatch on requests with query parameters
Corrected error response schema for insufficient funds
Initial v1 API release — existing v0 endpoints moved to `/v0/` prefix
OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow for API authentication
